title: DarkMusic 1.5.26 Release
changelog:
• Bold Sans-Serif Section Typography: Scaled up font size to 25.5sp with Apple Music SF Pro bold sans-serif across all section headers and greeting.
• Modern Library Navigation Icon: Redesigned the navigation bar Library icon with a clean, authentic books/library collection symbol without music notes.
• Session-Persistent Most Played Order: Randomized top 30 tracks remain rock-solid throughout your session and only re-randomize when closing and reopening the app.
• Liquid Glass Navigation Bar: Transparent frosted backdrop blur with specular light rim and clean outlined/filled icon states.
releaseNotes: v1.5.26: Enlarged bold sans-serif headings, fresh Library navigation icon, rock-solid session-persistent Most Played order, and frosted liquid glass navigation bar.
